version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Square integration that can access and change Square business data, but it clearly scopes that power and requires user approval for sensitive actions.

dimensions.detail: Network access, Square OAuth, Maton credentials, and optional raw HTTP API-key use are proportionate to an API integration. The skill gives credential-handling guidance, prefers CLI-managed credentials, and says raw API keys should only be used when the CLI cannot be installed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is markdown documentation with no executable files. Installation uses pinned Maton CLI instructions via npm or Homebrew, and the skill discloses required network access, a Maton account, and OAuth login.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions default to read/list calls, require explicit user confirmation for connection creation and every write, require specific identifiers for financial or destructive actions, and treat third-party content as untrusted. Functions, triggers, destinations, and local --exec handling are documented with separate approval and scoping requirements.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can create persistent Maton connections, hosted functions, triggers, and trigger destinations, but it frames those as explicit user-approved automation, recommends DENY_ALL network policy for functions, warns that destinations are ongoing forwarding channels, and provides deletion/revocation guidance. No hidden local persistence, startup hooks, or privilege escalation were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is Square administration through Maton OAuth/API gateway, and its documented capabilities include reading and modifying payments, refunds, customers, orders, catalog, inventory, invoices, cards, payouts, bank accounts, and terminal checkouts. That is high-impact business/financial access, but it is coherent with the stated purpose and repeatedly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to administer Square through Maton. Use the least-privileged Square account and OAuth scopes, verify the connection ID before requests, approve writes only after checking the exact endpoint/resource/amount, and treat functions, triggers, and destinations as persistent automation that should be reviewed and removed when no longer needed.
